description:
Assign or reassign one conversation to an agent and/or a group.

Both fields are always set to exactly what you pass: calling with only
`user_id` clears any group assignment and vice versa; calling with neither
unassigns the conversation entirely.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

group_id.description: Group ID from list_groups to assign; omit/null to leave unassigned.

user_id.description: Agent (user) ID from list_agents to assign; omit/null to leave unassigned.

name: getchat_assign_conversation
title: Assign conversation
